surfaces: procedural (desk, concrete, wood, bin plastic, fabric, wall, metal, tile); no photo surfaces, because the repo photo pool holds no empty scene
holdout_disjoint_from: separate RNG stream and surface parameters; no shared photo files are involved
transforms: render_empty(): tilt, shear, 0.35-1.60 brightness (10% dim), colour cast, shadow ramp, 0-2 glare hotspots, blur, motion blur, noise sigma 0-12, JPEG q40-95, 10% covered lens
note: train/val 數量跟其他四類的最少者對齊；holdout 只量 false-accept，永不訓練。
